records.tagline: Turn passive visitors into high value, repeat customers.
records.description: Stop guessing what games your users like. Dailyplay.ai connects directly to your brand’s data to launch Hyper-Personalized Engagements. While others offer "one-size-fits-all" quizzes, we use live data to build custom quests tailored to individual user segments. Standout features include our AI Assisted builder which scans and builds you a branded mini game in less than 3 minutes, and the wide array of data integrations!

records.name: Sonicribe
records.tagline: The fastest offline voice-to-text app for Mac and Windows
records.description: The fastest offline voice-to-text app for Mac and Windows. No login require. 10,000 words free per week. 40,000 words per month processing. Only Activates during the use and inactive while not using. Instant processing using GPU with fastest processing ever. Powered by Whisper AI, 100% local processing, no subscription. Vocab can be bulk import and export with excel. 5 different visual mode with customization option. One-time $79 purchase.

records.name: TrayPong
records.tagline: Classic Pong in Your macOS Menu Bar
records.description: TrayPong — Pong in your macOS menu bar TrayPong is a fast, minimalist take on Pong that’s always one click away. No Dock, no app switching—click to play, click away to close. 60fps gameplay with trails + screen shake, procedural chiptune audio (no files), adaptive AI, and a local leaderboard. Built with Electron + React. Completely FREE.

records.name: Omnilogin
records.tagline: Antidetect browser for multi-account management
records.description: Tired of losing accounts after spending months building them? Omnilogin is an antidetect browser built on Chromium that creates fully isolated browser profiles with unique, emulated fingerprints making each account appear as a distinct real user. Built for marketers, agencies, crypto teams & e-commerce sellers who operate at scale. Features include no-code automation via Drag & Drop, SOCKS5 UDP proxy, unlimited IPv6, mobile fingerprint emulation, REST API, and multi-level team access.

records.name: Mybets.gg - Sports Bet Tracker
records.tagline: AI-powered bet tracker
records.description: Ditch the spreadsheets. Mybets.gg is the AI bet tracker that turns screenshots into logged wagers. Upload a betslip or use our Chrome snipping tool and AI extracts & logs bets instantly. Manual entry stays free & unlimited forever. Your dashboard auto calculates P&L, tracks streaks & surfaces analytics. Built by a bettor tired of manual data entry. Free to start. Track every bet, find your edge.

records.name: FreezeFrame
records.tagline: Real moments only. No filters. Your 24h becomes one story.
records.description: Social media became about perfect highlights and edited lives. FreezeFrame brings back real moments. Only real-time camera capture allowed — no filters, no gallery uploads, no editing. Everything you share in 24 hours automatically merges into one single daily story. Choose who sees it — Open 🔓 anyone can view Lock 🔒 double tap to unlock Super Lock - request access required No pressure. No fake moments. Just real life as it happens. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: PetPal Academy
records.tagline: Personalized pet teacher for kids education
records.description: This app tranforms pets into personalized teachers for children. Upload an image of your pet, and the app makes a teacher that will educate kids on first principle thinking, geography and vocabulary.

records.name: Quote Keep
records.tagline: Quote Keep — Save, share & organize your favorite quotes.
records.description: Quote Keep is a fast, distraction-free quote library that helps you capture, tag, and search your favorite lines in seconds. Unlike generic note apps, it’s built specifically for quotes—with clean organization, quick adding, and easy search so you can actually find what inspired you later. Create beautiful shareable quote images with the built-in quote image builder, then share to social or send to friends in a couple of taps.

records.name: TypeFart
records.tagline: Your keyboard farts. Your touchpad moans. That's it.
records.description: Your laptop has opinions now Three ways your Windows laptop will never let you type in peace. Type on your keyboard -Every keypress triggers a sound. Fart, funny, or mechanical Use your touchpad - Swipe, tap, scroll — your touchpad now moans. Pick from 4 packs - Fart, Funny, Keyboard, or Sexy. Mix keyboard and touchpad sounds however you want.

records.name: Tech Marketing Framework
records.tagline: Forkable GTM system for builders struggling with marketing
records.description: You built something awesome. You post it on X and....get 2 likes. Distribution is hard. This Claude GTM system gives you a marketing engine, distilled from my experience as an AI pilled marketing VP for early stage tech startups. It has: - Agents and skills that compress your time to launch - Interactive workshop to nail messaging - Extensive channel directory to find where your audience actually hangs out - Asset generation (incl imgs!) Free to use, updated daily, obsessively maintained.

records.name: BailaYa
records.tagline: Effortless bookings for dance studios
records.description: BailaYa is transitioning from closed beta to public launch and will be generally available. Following 3 years of development and constant improvements, we are launching our dance studio management platform to the public. BailaYa helps dance studios increase the number of student bookings, along with improving retention and staff productivity. Studios are able to accept booking payments online through various payment gateways and secure payment before classes, reducing the risk of no-shows.

records.name: FDM AI Document Translation
records.tagline: Unlock Global Content with AI Document Translation
records.description: AI TranslatorPro is part of the Free Document Maker ecosystem. We provide 100% free neural translation with no hidden costs, no subscriptions, and no watermarks on your exported PDFs.

records.name: Claude for Word
records.tagline: Bring Claude natively into your Microsoft Word workflow
records.description: Claude is now natively integrated into Microsoft Word. Draft, edit, and resolve comments directly from the sidebar. It preserves your exact formatting, outputs edits as native tracked changes, and shares context with Excel and PowerPoint.

records.name: Vequil
records.tagline: Deploy AI agent teams to trade prediction markets
records.description: Vequil is a multi-agent prediction market trading framework. pip install vequil-sdk and deploy autonomous agent teams that scan Polymarket for opportunities, debate them with LLM analysts (bull vs bear), size positions with Kelly criterion, and execute with full audit trails. No learned models in the execution path. Deterministic signal rules. Every decision logged. Built by a prop trading firm. Now open to everyone.

records.name: LightningWindowSwitcher
records.tagline: Search and switch windows lightning fast
records.description: LightningWindowSwitcher is a fast macOS/Windows utility that lets you switch, search, and manage open windows instantly with keyboard-first workflows.

records.name: Memochat
records.tagline: Turn AI Chats into Flashcards, Notes & Quizzes
records.description: Memochat transforms your ChatGPT conversations into study-ready flashcards, notes, and quizzes. Start studying smarter today.

records.name: Rank My Apps
records.tagline: Find apps that win. Learn why they rank. Build smarter apps.
records.description: ASO tools to generate ASO-optimized app titles, subtitles, and descriptions for App Store and Google Play, plus insights into recently launched apps gaining rapid installs.

records.name: Media Flow
records.tagline: 14+ free browser-based tools — PDF, images. Zero uploads
records.description: Media Flow is a free, privacy-first toolkit with 14+ tools that run entirely in your browser: • PDF merge, split, convert to image, add watermark • Image compression, resize, mosaic censor • QR Code generator, JSON formatter • HTML generator, text-to-HTML, HTML-to-URL hosting • AI meeting transcription (upload audio → get transcript + summary) No account needed. No file uploads to servers. Works in Chinese, English, and Japanese.

records.name: Mathzen: Active recall workout
records.tagline: Math workout, math formula, rules, math shortcut, speed math
records.description: Unlike existing math workout application mathzen provides unique active recall, guided recall and other techniques along with traditional practice workout of speed math which helps students and aspirants remember math Formula and Value faster and effectively in their long term memory.

records.name: Virtual Patro:Nepali Calendar
records.tagline: Modern calendar, traditional soul.
records.description: Virtual Patro is a modern Nepali calendar app approved by the Nepal Panchanga Nirnayak Samiti. It offers both online and offline access to essential calendar features for individuals and institutions.

records.name: Capso
records.tagline: Free open-source screenshot & screen recorder for Mac
records.description: Capso is a free, open-source screenshot and screen recording app for Mac (Apple Silicon), built entirely in Swift. ✨ Features: • Screenshot (area, window, fullscreen) • Screen recording • Annotation tools • OCR (text from images) • Image beautification Think CleanShot X or Cap — but completely free and open source. No subscriptions, no paywalls, no telemetry. Just a clean, native Mac app that does everything you need.
